summary: Iteration 3 backend re-test after raising MAX_TOKENS budgets AND adding BadRequestError auto-retry with 2x token budget on json_validate_failed / max_tokens errors in _llm_call(). Extended pytest suite from 11 to 12 tests: added assertions for keywords >=1, methodology.strengths >=1, no workflow_error events in SSE replay, and a full 2nd analysis run on the same paper. All 12 tests passed in 30.66s. The full analysis run completed cleanly with tldr non-empty, paper_score>0, gaps>=1, keywords>=1, methodology.strengths>=1, questions>=1, final_report>400 chars, and ZERO workflow_error events observed in the SSE replay. The 2nd re-run over the same paper_id also completed successfully with no workflow_error. Standard endpoints (/api/upload, /api/papers, /api/paper/{id}, DELETE, /api/stats, /api/semantic-search, /api/search, /api/paper/{id}/pin) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: The BadRequestError retry loop in _llm_call() shares its counter (`retries=3`) with the 429 backoff path — a paper whose JSON keeps exceeding budget could still eventually fail, but the cap at 3500 tokens and doubling from >=450 gives good headroom.
agents.py is ~700 lines and mixes agent nodes, prompts, and orchestration — consider splitting into agents/ package (one file per node) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /tmp/mtech.pdf during test; deleted at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_research_run.py now covers: basic endpoints, upload+SSE disconnect resilience, full analysis validation (tldr/score/gaps/keywords/methodology/questions/report), SSE replay without workflow_error, 2nd analysis run on same paper, and delete. Total ~31s on current Groq quota. The bug reported (400 json_validate_failed) did NOT reproduce — fix confirmed working.
